scope: Critical-defect source preflight for obviously painted/baked highlights in generated baseline albedo textures.
changes: Added QualityBlockAlbedoLightingNeutralityQA.cs. It inspects generated GeneratedPBR *_Albedo.png source pixels independently of TextureImporter readability, verifies sRGB import intent, decodes source color values to linear luminance for analysis, fits a broad 8x8 luminance plane, measures centre-vs-edge bias, and measures opposite-edge tile seam RMSE.

Added albedo_lighting_neutrality_contract.json with fail-closed thresholds, required baseline textures, the physical base-color/PBR split, explicit limitations, zero automatic Visual Fidelity points and runtime-render verification pending.

Integrated the contract and generated-source test into Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet both before reflection-probe rendering and again after the sealed still set before temporal capture. A failed source test stops the authoritative evidence path rather than being hidden with grading/sharpening or a relaxed gate.
